basic_info.description: Prime location in Little Hollywood!  Well-kept 2-bedrooms /1-bathroom semi-detached house on Cul-de-Sac with approx. 1,277 sq.ft. built in 1946.  This two-story home features new flooring throughout the living and formal dining area.  Spacious kitchen with granite countertops along with dining area.  Updated bathrooms, dual-pane windows and low maintenance leveled backyard.  Additional 1-bedroom / 1-bathroom in-law potential.  Conveniently located near Little Hollywood Park, Caltrain, SF Muni T-Line.  Easy access to HWY 101, Bayshore Blvd., SFO, and minutes away from San Francisco Downtown, Chase Center, Oracle Park, UCSF & Cow Palace.
